question: Should Cistanche tubulosa be recommended for: use as a food supplement / food for special medical purposes in the EU?

records.notes: The European Commission terminated the novel-food authorisation procedure for water extract of Cistanche tubulosa stems without updating the Union list of authorised novel foods, following an EFSA opinion that concluded the safety of the extract had not been established.
records.source_title: Commission Implementing Decision terminating the authorisation procedure for water extract of Cistanche tubulosa stems as a novel food
records.target_indication: use as a food supplement / food for special medical purposes in the EU
records.primary_outcome: use as a food supplement / food for special medical purposes in the EU
